ipa.surfaces.swaption.Definition

Create a Swaption data Definition object.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.surfaces.swaption.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    *,
    surface_layout: SurfaceLayout = None,
    surface_parameters: SwaptionCalculationParams | None = None,
    underlying_definition: dict | SwaptionSurfaceDefinition = None,
    surface_tag: OptStr = None,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
surface_layout SurfaceLayout No None See details in SurfaceLayout class
surface_parameters SwaptionCalculationParams | None No None See details in SwaptionCalculationParams class
underlying_definition dict | SwaptionSurfaceDefinition No None Dict or EtiSurfaceDefinition object. See details in EtiSurfaceDefinition class Example: {"fxCrossCode": "EURUSD"}
surface_tag OptStr No None A user defined string to describe the volatility surface
extended_params ExtendedParams No None If necessary other parameters

Methods

get_data

Sends a request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

get_data(session: Session | None = None, async_mode: bool | None = None)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.
async_mode bool | None No None

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

get_data_async

Sends an asynchronous request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

async get_data_async(
    session: Session | None = None,
    on_response: Callable | None = None,
    async_mode: bool | None = None,
    closure: str | None = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.
on_response Callable | None No None Callable function to process the retrieved data.
async_mode bool | None No None
closure str | None No None Closure parameters that will be returned with the response.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

Example

from lseg.data.content.ipa.surfaces import swaption
definition = swaption.Definition(
    underlying_definition=swaption.SwaptionSurfaceDefinition(
        instrument_code="USD",
        discounting_type=swaption.DiscountingType.OIS_DISCOUNTING
    ),
    surface_tag="USD_Strike__Tenor_",
    surface_layout=swaption.SurfaceLayout(
        format=swaption.Format.MATRIX
    ),
    surface_parameters=swaption.SwaptionCalculationParams(
        x_axis=swaption.Axis.TENOR,
        y_axis=swaption.Axis.STRIKE,
        calculation_date="2020-03-20"
    )
)
